title: Hierarchical CuO photocathodes with cobalt doping for efficient photoelectrochemical water-splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24612-24623
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04234H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alaa M. Ibrahim, Ahmed Rida Galaly, Mohamed Sh. Abdel-wahab, Mohamed Shaban, Wael Z. Tawfik, M. T. Tammam
This study focuses on the development of Co–CuO thin film with hierarchical morphology to serve as a promising photoelectrode for efficient photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting, enabling environmentally friendly H2 production.
